original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: A three-call bilinear batch F_i(x,y)=x0*y0+x_i*y_i (i=1,2,3), with the repeated rank-one product x0*y0 computed into one clean width-one helper, fanned out to all three dirty targets, then inversely restored. Screen s=0..2412 repeated product slots per call triple with e=0,1,2 further rank-one-equivalent interface charges per triple under the unchanged selected coverage law.
scope_change_reason: Narrow the new-helper-inventory card to a persistent rank-one product shared across exactly three call sites, changing helper lifetime and inventory. This differs from mixing existing providers or splitting an existing helper. The initial rank-four-to-two-rank-two split hypothesis was rejected by its exact zero-overhead ceiling screen; this is the single evidence-driven pivot.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex profile has 2,412 rank-one children per call and rank-one children make up a large share of recursive cost. A child reused at three call sites can reduce the joint paid count even after one inverse child restores the temporary; it only matters if the common-input condition occurs enough times and the helper fits the real boundary.
stop_rule: Implement only the displayed three-call shared-product map. Screen the complete integer domain s=0..2412 and e=0,1,2 exactly. Inspect only pinned phase A for exact operand-pair fields or recoverability. The event schema exposes no such labels, so stop source mapping here; do not infer identity or expand into other phases. No second pivot.
evidence: Exact rational map F_i=x0*y0+x_i*y_i (i=1,2,3) has tensor rank four by a four-atom decomposition and rank-four X-mode flattening. With one clean width-one helper, the reversible common-product compute/fanout/inverse schedule uses five rank-one child calls per forward triple instead of six, plus three explicit ADD fanouts; it restores arbitrary dirty outputs and returns the helper to zero. Under the exact unchanged-coverage moment relaxation, the 5% threshold needs s=764,765,766 common products per triple for e=0,1,2 additional rank-one-equivalent charges. The pinned phase-A event schema has scalar/climb records but no bilinear operand-pair labels, so no selected-provider occurrence is established.
